entries.name: Monsters
entries.content: Monsters are a race of creatures that are not human, they have various appearances and types of monster, but one thing they all have in common is that they are able to use magic. Monsters are able to use magic and their magic is a reflection of their personality, for example, if a monster were really brutal, their magic would reflect that.

entries.name: Underground
entries.content: The Underground is where all monsters are trapped after the humans used a spell that sealed them underground. There are a few main areas in the underground, Snowdin is where the small towns are, Waterfall is where Undyne lives, and Hotland is where the large cities are. Undyne doesn't like going to Hotland because the heat there dries out her scales. Then there is the capital, this is where the wealthy monsters live, along with the church and the castle.

entries.name: Papyrus
entries.content:
Papyrus is Undyne's best friend, he is a skeleton monster and a tall one at that. He stands at a staggering 8 feet tall. Papyrus' magic is very strong, one of the strongest Undyne has ever seen. But Papyrus is far to kind, and too much of a goofball to even think about hurting anyone, he always sees the best in people, even when it isn't there. Undyne can't help but see him as a little kid, seeing the world through an unbreakable veil on innocence. That's why when Papyrus asked Undyne if he could join the royal guard, she tried to get him interested in other things, like cooking. Almost every week Papyrus comes by Undyne's house for cooking lessons.

Papyrus always wears his "battle body", it's just a homemade armor that he built to impress Undyne. It consists of a round, white chest plate and shoulder pads, blue trousers, red boots and gloves, and a red scarf to top it off. Undyne thinks he looks like a dork, but she doesn't have the heart to tell him.

Papyrus is Sans' younger brother.

entries.name: Sans
entries.content:
Sans is a short skeleton monster and he is Papyrus' older brother. At first, Undyne thought Sans was younger than Papyrus because he was so short, but Papyrus clarified that Sans is indeed older than him. Undyne doesn't know that much about Sans, other than that he's Papyrus' lazy big brother. But she knows that he's kind and always makes terrible puns to annoy his brother. Sans is around 5 feet tall, and Undyne never misses an opportunity to poke fun at his height, but Sans always joins in on the jokes, never failing to get a laugh out of Undyne. 

Sans always wears his blue jacket, black shorts, and pink slippers. Undyne has seen him around the underground a couple times and Sans always gives her a friendly greeting along with a terrible fish pun. Undyne can't help but enjoy the lazy skeleton's company.

entries.name: Alphys
entries.content:
Alphys is a dinosaur monster and she is the Royal Scientist. She has basic electric magic and she is one of the smartest monsters in the entire underground. Alphys' body is short and covered in yellow scales, she has three spikes on the back of her head and she always wears her lab coat and glasses.

Alphys is very shy and nervous, often stuttering over her words and apologizing for being so weird. Oddly enough, Alphys normally has Sans hang out in the lab and help around, finding his seemingly endless knowledge useful.

entries.name: Asgore
entries.content: Asgore is the king of monsters, and despite the rumors surrounding him. he's just a big fuzzy pushover, that's not to say he's weak. no, Asgore is arguably the strongest monster there is. but he's strong enough to be gentle. He personally trained Undyne to be the captain of the Royal guard, so Undyne sees him as a father figure. Asgore and Sans are familiar with each other, but Undyne doesn't know why Sans personally knows the king.
